description: Wärmeplanung (Zielszenario) Trier - Eignung Wasserstoffnetzgebiet 2045 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Trier. For municipal heating planning, the Climate Protection Act stipulates that climate-neutral heat supply should be guaranteed by 2050, i.e. that no more greenhouse gas emissions may be caused by 2050 at the latest. Coverage: Stadt Trier. The portal shows the English title as "Thermal planning (target scenario) Trier - suitability hydrogen network area 2045" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadt Trier. Its keywords include Stadtwerke (Wärmeversorgung), Energieressourcen, Kommunalpolitik, Wärme, Energiebilanz, Erneuerbare Energiequelle. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-04-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
